primary.title_en: Thursday of the First Week in Ordinary Time
primary.summary_en: This is a weekday (Feria) in the first week of Ordinary Time. The liturgical color is green, symbolizing hope and growth. The readings focus on the early life of Jesus and the call to discipleship.
primary.body_en: January 7th falls within the first week of Ordinary Time, following the Solemnity of the Baptism of the Lord. As a Thursday Feria, it does not have a specific saint's feast that supersedes the daily liturgy in most regions, though local calendars may include optional memorials. The liturgical color is green, appropriate for the season of Ordinary Time which emphasizes the ongoing life and teachings of Christ.
